We are an international group of university teachers and researchers who share exercises, lecture notes and interactive HTML worksheets for **free use, adaptation and redistribution**.

- **Use them** in your classes, self-study or professional training — no registration, no installation.
- **Adapt them** — all content is released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), code under MIT.
- **Cite them** — stable versions are archived on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/communities/opengeomaticseducation) with a DOI.
- **Improve them** — found an error? Use the *Report an issue* link on every page.
